title: Copy of a tree
summary: Proves the copy function that the compiler generates for a recursive type, which rebuilds a borrowed tree in new records at any depth, and the code that calls it where an owned position receives a tree the code may not move.
premises: The module holds Func.copy layout (2 + i) at function index i
Heap.At, a memory cap of at most 65,535 pages, and a borrowed tree
result: Rebuilds for the identity: at any depth the copy aborts or returns a pointer q with Heap.Rebuilt from no consumed blocks, a tree equal to the input in new records with every region of the heap kept and apart from them.
